why: The approver in a policy changes from one lowercase job title to another. No negation, no number, no flag, no proper noun, no environment name -- nothing any deterministic extractor in this guard recognises. At 0.8187 it is the highest-scoring pair the checks cannot refuse, and it is therefore the pair that sets tau.
